description: Get the signed-in user's own Levels.fyi career profile: current title, company, career level, job family, focus area, location, years of experience, skills, certifications and work history, plus the status of their resume (none, pending while it is being parsed, parsed, or failed) and when it was uploaded. Never returns contact details or the resume file. Use it to personalize answers about the user's own pay, level or career.
name: get-profile
